facts.fact: The DRC settled over $1.4m in arrears and penalties to the African Telecommunications Union, securing its automatic seat on the ATU Administrative Council; the document gives no date for the seat, so its published date is used.

The 7th ATU Plenipotentiary Conference in Abuja formally validated the move of the ATU headquarters from Nairobi to Kinshasa on 23 July 2026; the new Secretary-General is to take office there in January 2027.
